lexicalPaths: Complete selected source tree and canonical Git top-level, .git directory and common Git directory
Registry JSON as a separate finite metadata admission; never the global skills parent during checkout network work
Only actually missing managed/imported/default bundle targets and active recovery journal/cache paths

integrations.sourceReservationOrder: Nonqueued source ID and canonical checkout reservation first; release bookkeeping mutex before shared path admission; brief registry snapshots never retain REGISTRY_LOCK while waiting.
integrations.domainLockOrder: Complete shared path admission before REGISTRY_LOCK; source reservation survives network lease release and fresh complete commit acquisition.
notes: load_registry_unlocked and get_skill are pure reads. Lists take bounded registry/default initialization admission only for actually missing defaults, preserving healthy network-stage metadata access.
Checkout network lease excludes registry. Fresh commit atomically reacquires checkout plus registry/sidecars, revalidates source incarnation/config/content and rescans without retry.
Skill-specific mutation admission is implemented by SkillMutationAdmission.acquire and validate; the source checker resolves module functions and does not encode impl names.

Clone admits destination and unique staging during Git work, then reacquires both plus registry and rechecks generation/staged bytes before rename/commit. Bundle admits next/active/pristine/cache/env for preparation, then reacquires registry/install sidecars and rechecks prepared/pristine hashes, active state and dirty content before swap/rollback.

Synchronous run_env_repair_blocking uses configure_env_command cache overrides and creates temp under the owning precomputed bundle/environment admission; environment effects remain idempotent and unjournaled per the existing setup contract.

Selected symlink file targets are admitted in addition to the skill tree; target bytes and absent/new-file expectations are revalidated after waiting. Exact Git topology changes, including a new Git repository or metadata retarget inside an already covered tree, reject save/sync before mutation.

fixtureIsolationAudit.initialDispatchFailure: An initial dispatch launch-error fixture did not pin the actually selected binary and escaped its intended synthetic process boundary. External effects of that initial launch are unknown; the full execution history is not claimed isolated.
fixtureIsolationAudit.dispatchCorrection: The corrected fixture asserts the actual selected fake executable path and forces ENOENT at launch. Later passing results apply to the corrected fixture.
fixtureIsolationAudit.environmentCorrection: Test-only environment bootstrap pins /bin/bash on Unix and removes inherited BASH_ENV and ENV; production binary selection and environment behavior are unchanged.
fixtureIsolationAudit.verificationBoundary: The final confirmed 37-test run includes all five domain same-polling-task cases and the hardened fixture boundaries. This result does not establish isolation of the initial escaped dispatch launch.

regressionNotes: The former concurrent same-source save test now accepts immediate source_busy and performs an explicit retry after both original attempts settle, preserving D-02 and successful siblings.
The Git permission regression separately proves initial denial launches no Git, and a policy flip after authorized discovery launches no subsequent Git process.
